data.narrative: The student demonstrated outstanding mastery of API design and security boundaries in Module 03. They correctly identified the architectural benefits of route namespace separation for CDN edge routing, designed a robust Zod validation schema that repelled 10 distinct URL smuggling attacks, and immediately isolated an HTTP 200 vs 302 redirect defect during the incident phase.

dimension_scores.observation: Analyzed route prefix isolation (/r/:code) versus root routing, articulating why namespace boundaries protect internal endpoints and simplify CDN caching tiers.
dimension_scores.evidence: Chose Option A (Prefix Route) citing edge proxy routing efficiency and eliminating reserved-word collision maintenance.

dimension_scores.observation: Accurately diagnosed the root cause of an HTTP 200 response on public redirects without hints, identifying missing Location header assignment and 3xx status codes.
dimension_scores.evidence: Formulated hypothesis on controller returning res.json() instead of res.redirect(302), and cited curl -i as the fastest isolation test.

dimension_scores.observation: Understood the critical importance of URL validation as an absolute security perimeter against open redirects, stored XSS, and domain blacklisting.
dimension_scores.evidence: Outlined defenses against backslash smuggling, userinfo authentication tricks, and control character injection.

dimension_scores.observation: Connected HTTP status code semantics (400 vs 200/500) to operational observability, alerting hygiene, and search engine crawler behavior (410 Gone).
dimension_scores.evidence: Explained how 500s pollute Sentry error budgets and how 410 Gone prompts search engines to prune dead URLs from indexes.

dimension_scores.observation: Consistently delivered structured, technically accurate answers referencing RFC standards and production architectural patterns.
dimension_scores.evidence: Referenced RFC 9110 redirection requirements and structured explanations into concise security and infrastructure dimensions.

strengths: Exceptional grasp of HTTP status code semantics and web standards (RFC 9110).
Proactive defensive security mindset regarding input sanitization and URL smuggling vectors.
Rapid, precise root-cause analysis during production incident troubleshooting.
growth_areas: Continue applying this strict boundary discipline as we introduce tenant authentication and JWT validation middleware in Module 04.
data.recommendation: Maintain this high standard of defensive architecture when enforcing tenant scoping and authorization checks in Module 04.
